AI Settings

Your key is stored only in this browser. Text you send to the assistant goes directly from your browser to the provider you choose — nothing passes through Kiln. Only use a key you are allowed to use here, and avoid sending confidential documents.

Local servers: start Ollama with OLLAMA_ORIGINS=* so the browser may connect; a key is usually not needed.

My Add-ins

An add-in is a reusable AI button: give it a name and an instruction, and it appears in the AI tab.

Kiln keyboard shortcuts

Ctrl / Cmd + S Download .docx
Ctrl / Cmd + B Bold
Ctrl / Cmd + I Italic
Ctrl / Cmd + U Underline
Ctrl / Cmd + Z Undo
Ctrl / Cmd + Y Redo
Ctrl / Cmd + F Find
Ctrl / Cmd + H Find and replace
Ctrl / Cmd + K Insert link
Ctrl / Cmd + Enter New page (page break)
Tab / Shift + Tab Indent / outdent list item
Ctrl / Cmd + Shift + C / V Copy / paste formatting
Ctrl / Cmd + Shift + > / < Grow / shrink font
Shift + F3 Change case
Alt + X Unicode code ↔ character
Ctrl / Cmd + Shift + 8 Show formatting marks
Ctrl / Cmd + Alt + M New comment
Ctrl / Cmd + G Go to page
Ctrl / Cmd + mouse wheel Zoom
Ctrl / Cmd + Shift + E Track changes
Ctrl / Cmd + Alt + F Insert footnote
Ctrl / Cmd + Alt + D Insert endnote
Ctrl / Cmd + D Font dialog
Ctrl / Cmd + E / L / R / J Center / left / right / justify
Ctrl / Cmd + 1 / 2 / 5 Single / double / 1.5 line spacing
Ctrl / Cmd + M Indent paragraph
Ctrl / Cmd + Q Reset paragraph formatting
Ctrl / Cmd + Shift + A / K / D All caps / small caps / double underline
Ctrl / Cmd + Shift + Enter Column break
Alt + Shift + ← → ↑ ↓ Promote, demote, move paragraph
Alt + Shift + D / T Insert date / time
Alt + = Equation
F7 / Shift + F7 Spelling / Thesaurus
F9 Update all fields
Alt + Q Search commands
Ctrl / Cmd + F1 Show or hide the ribbon
Shift + right-click Browser menu with spelling suggestions

Files are saved locally in this browser, with offline Word export and import. Complex Word layouts may be simplified.
